fields.name: InCamp
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EB48B0 (size 0x10): byte 0 at +0, 12 zero bytes at +4. bg3.exe+0x2EB3320 creates it on the wielder (the entity that gets eoc::improvised_weapon::WieldingComponent) and writes the result of bg3.exe+0xAF0210 - 'entity has eoc::camp::PresenceComponent'. bg3.exe+0x2EB2C70 (putting the improvised weapon down) compares the wielder's current camp presence with this byte: equal -> the weapon is placed at the wielder's position, different -> another path.
